title: Advisory votes index — /consultations/index.json
description:
Every advisory vote the Association's board has opened, newest opening first, each with the header of its newest published version: its id, title and audience, whether it is a sample, its open period, what its newest version publishes, and that version's number, instant and SHA-256. The vote's full document is one file away, at `/consultations/{consultationId}.json` on the same plane (`consultation.v1`), and its `sha256` is the value listed here for the same version.

NO FIGURE OF ANY KIND. The index carries no count of people, no turnout and no result: every figure derived from who was asked is in the vote's own document, which carries the provisional label where it applies (FS06-020). So nothing here is derived from a contribution count, and nothing here can be subtracted from anything else.

WHAT THE NEWEST VERSION SAYS, read from `kind`: `announcement` — the vote is open and takes answers until `closesAt` (once that instant has passed, the close runs on its own, normally within minutes, and publishes the result); `result` — the vote closed at `closedAt` and the board's answer is pending; `answer` — the board has answered; `withdrawal` — the vote was withdrawn at `withdrawnAt` while it was open, and nothing was counted. A vote that was never opened is in no published document. A vote stays in the index whatever became of it: a withdrawal keeps its line, with that kind.

REGENERATED, NOT WRITTEN ONCE. It is rendered again whenever a vote publishes a version, and its `generatedAt` moves with every publication. A plane that read the platform's votes and found none publishes it with `consultations` empty; a plane that does not carry the family (the curated registry's, a sample plane) publishes no `/consultations/` path at all.

WHAT A READER CHECKS, stated here because JSON Schema cannot relate two documents or two entries: each `consultationId` is listed once; the entries are ordered by `openedAt`, newest first, and two opened in the same second by `consultationId`; each entry's `version`, `kind`, `publishedAt` and `sha256` are those of the vote's document at `/consultations/{consultationId}.json`, and its `title`, `audience`, `sample`, `openedAt` and `closesAt` that document's own; `closedAt` is the document's `closedAt`, and `withdrawnAt` its `withdrawal.at`; and `generatedAt` is never earlier than any `publishedAt`.

PRE-RELEASE. Nothing outside the build depends on this contract yet, so it changes in place inside its v1 until the public launch (versioning policy rule 5).

x-psn.phase: P-M3 (producer: `jobs.index-build`, from `consultation_publications`, platform migration 0098). Pre-release: published on the dev plane from the first index-build run after its renderer ships; not routed by the edge in v1.
x-psn.artifactPath: /consultations/index.json — regenerated; read from the plane at build time and mirrored by the site under /artifacts/consultations/; not served by the edge in v1
x-psn.producer: `jobs.index-build` (P-M3), from every stored version of every vote, beside each vote's own document (`consultation.v1`)
consumers: the public results page, /voting, which lists every vote with its state
anyone following the board's advisory votes, who reads each vote's document from here
fsRefs: FS-00 §1 (public surfaces read published artifacts only)

generatedAt.description: The plane's envelope instant (FS-00 §6.2): derived from the rows the build read, never from a clock. Every listed version's publication instant is among those rows, so it is never earlier than any `publishedAt` here.

source.description: Which plane produced this document, in the envelope's vocabulary (FS-00 §6.2), exactly as on `consultation.v1`: `platform` is `jobs.index-build` in `PSN_ENV=prod`, `fixture` every other environment, `sample` a sample plane. A `platform` index never lists a sample vote.

consultations.description: Every vote with a published version, newest `openedAt` first, each once. Empty until the first vote opens.

entry.description: One vote and its newest published version. `closedAt` is present exactly when `kind` is `result` or `answer`, and `withdrawnAt` exactly when it is `withdrawal`.

consultationId.description: The vote's id: `csl_` and a lowercase ULID. Its document is `/consultations/{consultationId}.json`.

title.description: The vote's title, as frozen at the opening.

audience.description: Whom the vote asks: people who contribute to a registered project, people who run one, or both.

sample.description: True for a vote taken on the test environment to try voting out; every surface that shows it marks it SAMPLE. Never true on a `platform` index.

closesAt.description: When it stops, or stopped, taking answers.

closedAt.description: When the close ran; on a `result` or an `answer` only.

withdrawnAt.description: When the vote was withdrawn; on a `withdrawal` only.

kind.description: What the newest version publishes: see the contract's description.

publishedAt.description: When the act that published the newest version ran.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the newest version's document in its RFC 8785 canonical form: the vote document's own `sha256`.

instant.description: A UTC instant to the second, FS-00 §6.1's one spelling.
